rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; model value dropped from the fixture. The case (fixtures/2025/classm.json, classm.f8880.4; married filing jointly) has the spouse born after January 1, 2008 (person[spouse].sav_born false) with a $665.00 Roth IRA contribution (person[spouse].sav_roth 66500), no other contribution or distribution. The model's work, "Spouse line 1 entries: 665.00 + 665.00 = 1330.00", counts the one $665.00 contribution twice; f8880 p. 1, line 1, "Traditional and Roth IRA contributions, and ABLE account contributions by the designated beneficiary for 2025", is that one contribution. The project's $665.00 is right on its reading (amb.2025.savers_ineligible_column puts the ineligible spouse's zero on line 6(b)).

Ruling: model error; model value dropped from the fixture. Two errors: the line 1(b) double count, and the Caution not applied at all. f8880 p. 1, Caution: "You cannot take this credit if either of the following applies. ... The person(s) who made the qualified contribution or elective deferral (a) was born after January 1, 2008; (b) is claimed as a dependent on someone else’s 2025 tax return; or (c) was a student"; the spouse was born after January 1, 2008, so the spouse's contribution gives no credit on any reading of amb.2025.savers_ineligible_column (the chosen reading zeroes the spouse's column on line 6(b), the other bars the whole credit). The model's $1,330.00 counts it; the project's $0.00 is right. The case (fixtures/2025/classm.json, classm.f8880.4; married filing jointly) has the spouse born after January 1, 2008 (person[spouse].sav_born false) with a $665.00 Roth IRA contribution (person[spouse].sav_roth 66500), no other contribution or distribution.
